Decided by: Weekly sync attendees (Maya Okafor, Tom Lindqvist, Priya Raman, Daniel Reyes, Sofia Marchetti, Kenji Watanabe) on 2026-10-13.

Notes: Kenji to stop the Vonage rollout; Priya to redesign SMS templates for Sinch by 2026-10-30.

payload.note: Decision replaces prior choice of Vonage due to delivery failures on Portuguese numbers.
